environment.initialWindow: navigation to load + 2000ms, no scroll or interaction; requests completed within window
environment.networkMethod: CDP Network.loadingFinished encodedDataLength, response cache provenance; disk/memory cache transfer zero; request completion inside window; transfer includes HTTP response headers where CDP reports them, excludes transport-layer overhead
environment.decodedMethod: Aggregate uses CDP Network.dataReceived dataLength; ResourceTiming decodedBodySize and navigation decodedBodySize are additionally retained in raw rows and never added to CDP totals. Warm cached dataReceived can undercount logical decoded resources; cross-origin ResourceTiming requires TAO.
environment.limitations: co-located ARM Docker; CDP simulated network and CPU; no deployed CDN/real-user metrics

identity.startTimeNote: Unavailable: original /proc stat parser split a parenthesized process name containing whitespace; discarded erroneous 0 rather than presenting it as start time.
identity.serverImageCache: pre-existing; potentially warm from prior QA, not cleared

method.encoded: CDP Network.loadingFinished encodedDataLength for requests completing within window; memory/disk cache explicitly zero; not TCP/TLS bytes; no double counting ResourceTiming
method.decoded: CDP Network.dataReceived dataLength summed for reported chunks, including document; cache entries may emit no data event, so not full logical decoded page size on warm
method.window: load plus 2000ms, before interaction or scroll; includes automatic viewport prefetch and near-viewport lazy loads; pending requests excluded from transfer
method.cls: maximum observed 5s/1s session window without recent input through capture; not field CLS
method.longTasks: observed until capture; sum(max(duration-50,0)) is a bounded lab proxy, not Lighthouse TBT
method.serviceWorker: fresh contexts, default allowed, observed controller captured in rows.json
method.uncertainty: single observation per route/profile/cache, no field INP, CrUX, Lighthouse score or deployed/CDN measurement

raw: rows.json and scroll.json retain CDP records and PerformanceObserver/ResourceTiming; full URLs retained with Next image width/quality identity
